youtube.title: Mittens' Opposites! Big and Small (SWISH!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🐱 SWISH! Mittens the cat swished her tail and all the opposite words flew away! Can you help Mittens find them?

Learn opposites with Mittens: BIG and SMALL, NIGHT and DAY, UP and DOWN! Mittens visits the farm, the pond, the night sky, the clouds and the ocean, and you hear the REAL sounds of the cow, the frog, the rooster and the bird. Then sing the opposites song with Mittens, and stay till the end, because someone is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn what opposites are
✔️ Learn 3 opposite pairs: big/small, night/day, up/down
✔️ Hear real animal sounds: cow, frog, rooster and bird
✔️ Sing an opposites song with Mittens!
